findings.claim: The Redis session store sets ttl: 600 seconds, which overrides the 24h cookie maxAge, so server-side sessions expire after 10 minutes.
findings.would_refute: A different ttl being applied at runtime, or Redis keys showing a 24h expiry

findings.claim: app.set('trust proxy') is never called in src/server.ts, so with cookie secure: true behind the TLS-terminating load balancer the session cookie is dropped.
findings.would_refute: A trust proxy setting anywhere in the app bootstrap

findings.claim: The session config sets rolling: true, so activity keeps refreshing the session expiry.
